messages:
Mara: quick capture so i don't forget before i write the mini-rfc: hinted credits causing dup/orphan audit refs during replay.
Sam: short problem statement?
Mara: when compacted credits are emitted before canonical provenance exists, a restart/replay can split or duplicate emissions.
Tony: we've seen duplicate charge in staging after consumer restart.
Lee: options: (1) finalizer-level dedupe using deterministic fingerprint; (2) change credit shape to carry provenance_state and let finalizer enrich later; (3) hybrid: emit hint + finalize via CAS.
Sam: hybrid seems pragmatic: fast emit + finalizer CAS to claim fingerprint and write canonical_provenance_id; unresolved hints handled by nightly reconcile.
Tony: need tie-break/CAS semantics to avoid two finalizers both winning. reuse existing lease service.
Lee: storage: online fingerprint map 90d, daily snapshot to warehouse for 12mo retention; finance needs UI flags for provisional charges.
Mara: proposed credit shape: {credit_id, tenant_id, amount, fingerprint, provenance_state} where provenance_state in ["hint","canonical","repaired"]. auditors can resolve fingerprint->canonical via mapping endpoint.
Sam: add compensating negative credits if reconcile finds duplicate billing. metrics: credits.enrichment_pending, credits.duplicates, billing.provisional_count.
DeployBot: rollout suggestion: canary 10% tenants, monitor 48h -> 50% -> 100%.
Mara: i'll PR mini-rfc with sequence diagrams and CAS pseudocode. Tony/Lee to review CAS and retention/export respectively.
